sn35.75:6.1: No ce kira tvam bhikkhu sīlavisuddhattham mayā dhammam desitam ājānāsi || atha kimatthaṃ carahi tvam bhikkhu mayā dhammaṃ desitam ajānāsīti || ||
sn35.75:7.1: Anupādāparinibbāṇatthaṃ khvāham bhante Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmīti || || 12
sn35.75:8.2: sādhu kho pana tvam bhikkhu anupādāparinibbāṇattham mayā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāsi ||
sn35.75:8.3: anupādāparinibbānattho hi bhikkhu mayā dhammo desito || || 13-14
sn35.75:18.2: Attamano so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinandi ||
sn35.75:18.3: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmim bhaññamāne tassa bhikkhussa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatīti || || 2
